consumer: The pickup path's carry-weight eligibility check asking 'does this item's weight fit within remaining carrying capacity (weight_capacity minus weight_carried)?'
scope: The avatar's weight-capacity predicate over current carried weight vs. max carry weight, compared against the specific candidate item's weight
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar(scalars) writes hp/stamina/moves/pain/thirst/fatigue/kcal getters into snapshot JSON; it never emits weight_carried, weight_capacity, or the item's weight, so it cannot answer the fit predicate
divergence: Avatar at full hp/stamina/kcal but already near max carry weight tries to pick up a heavy item: the scalar status block reports healthy values while the engine's weight-capacity predicate would deny the pickup
